mapper.select: SELECT f.BID_CASE_ID, f.FORM_CD, f.TASK_CD, f.CUR_VER, f.CONFIRMED_VER, f.CONFIRMED_SHA256, f.CONFIRMED_BY, f.CONFIRMED_VERIFIED, f.CONFIRMED_AT, f.CREATED_BY, f.CREATED_AT, f.UPDATED_BY, f.UPDATED_AT, u.NAME AS CONFIRMED_BY_NAME FROM BID_PREP_FORM f LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = f.CONFIRMED_BY WHERE f.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND f.FORM_CD = #{formCd}

SELECT BID_CASE_ID, FORM_CD, TASK_CD, CUR_VER, CONFIRMED_VER, CONFIRMED_SHA256, CONFIRMED_BY, CONFIRMED_VERIFIED, CONFIRMED_AT, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM BID_PREP_FORM WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND FORM_CD = #{formCd} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID_PREP_FORM (BID_CASE_ID, FORM_CD, TASK_CD, CUR_VER, CONFIRMED_VERIFIED, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{formCd}, #{taskCd}, 0, 0, #{by}, #{now}, #{by}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE BID_PREP_FORM SET CONFIRMED_VER = #{ver}, CONFIRMED_SHA256 = #{sha}, CONFIRMED_BY = #{by}, CONFIRMED_VERIFIED = #{verified}, CONFIRMED_AT = #{now}, UPDATED_BY = #{by}, UPDATED_AT = #{now} WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND FORM_CD = #{formCd} AND CUR_VER = #{ver} AND CONFIRMED_VER IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT v.BID_CASE_ID, v.FORM_CD, v.VER_NO, v.KIND_CD, v.BASE_VER, v.TPL_VER, v.RENDER_VER, v.CONTENT_JSON, v.CONTENT_SHA256, v.CONTENT_BYTES, v.SAVED_BY, v.SAVED_VERIFIED, v.SAVED_AT, u.NAME AS SAVED_BY_NAME FROM BID_PREP_FORM_VER v LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = v.SAVED_BY WHERE v.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND v.FORM_CD = #{formCd} AND v.VER_NO = #{verNo}

SELECT v.VER_NO, v.KIND_CD, v.BASE_VER, u.NAME AS SAVED_BY_NAME, v.SAVED_AT, v.CONTENT_SHA256 FROM BID_PREP_FORM_VER v LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.EMP_NO = v.SAVED_BY WHERE v.BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND v.FORM_CD = #{formCd} ORDER BY v.VER_NO DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BID_PREP_FORM_VER WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND FORM_CD = #{formCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BID_PREP_FORM_VER (BID_CASE_ID, FORM_CD, VER_NO, KIND_CD, BASE_VER, TPL_VER, RENDER_VER, CONTENT_JSON, CONTENT_SHA256, CONTENT_BYTES, SAVED_BY, SAVED_VERIFIED, SAVED_AT) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{formCd}, #{verNo}, #{kindCd}, #{baseVer}, #{tplVer}, #{renderVer}, #{contentJson,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{contentSha256}, #{contentBytes}, #{savedBy}, #{savedVerified}, #{savedAt})

INSERT INTO BID_PREP_LOG (BID_CASE_ID, EVENT_CD, FROM_STATE, TO_STATE, TASK_CD, REASON, ACTOR_EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, LOGGED_AT, FORM_VER) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{eventCd}, #{fromState,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toState,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taskCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actorEmpNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{verified}, #{now}, #{formVer,jdbcType=NUMERIC})

INSERT INTO BID_PREP_ACT (BID_CASE_ID, ACTION_CD, OUTCOME, STATE_CD, TASK_CD, ACTOR_EMP_NO, EMP_VERIFIED, SCREEN_ID, BUTTON_ID, UI_VALID, LOGGED_AT, FORM_VER) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{actionCd}, #{outcome}, #{stateCd}, #{taskCd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{actorEmpNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{verified}, #{screenId}, #{buttonId}, #{uiValid}, #{now}, #{formVer,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BID_ASSIGNMENT WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND ACTIVE_YN = 1
SELECT ASSIGNEE FROM TASKS WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId} AND TEAM = #{team}
SELECT NAME_KO, TYPE FROM INSTITUTIONS WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId}

SELECT i.FIELD_NAME, i.ITEM_NAME, i.CONTENT, i.PARENT_NO FROM INST_PLAN_ITEM i JOIN INST_PLAN_DOC d ON d.DOC_ID = i.DOC_ID WHERE i.IMPORT_ID = #{importId} AND i.PARENT_NO IS NULL ORDER BY d.DOC_SEQ, i.ROW_NO
